notes.title: Rangerdog 1.01
notes.content:
(Super late update notes)

- Changed lowering item level when getting hit.
- Longer invincible time at the time of resurrection.
- Added character descriptions.
・ Japanese support for options and explanations.
- New clear screen.
- Addition of scoring items during stages.
- Item tutorial tips at the start of the game can now be turned off after the second play.
- Added very hard mode after clearing hard mode.
- Added so that the icon of your own dog appears on the ranking screen.
- Level balance changes for item appearances, HP of some enemy characters, and correction of background graphics.
